# Generated Cmake Pico project file

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Initialise pico_sdk from installed location
# (note this can come from environment, CMake cache etc)

# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.2.0)
set(toolchainVersion 14_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.2.0-a4)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
set(PICO_BOARD pico CACHE STRING "Board type")

# Pull in Raspberry Pi Pico SDK (must be before project)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

# Nombre del proyecto final
project(Monitor_Final C CXX ASM)

# Initialise the Raspberry Pi Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# 1. Enlazar la subcarpeta de la librería FatFS 
add_subdirectory(no-OS-FatFS-SD-SPI-RPi-Pico/FatFs_SPI)

# 2. Declarar el ejecutable apuntando a main.c y hw_config.c
add_executable(Monitor_Final main.c hw_config.c)

pico_set_program_name(Monitor_Final "Monitor_Final")
pico_set_program_version(Monitor_Final "1.0")

# Forzar la consola a través del cable USB
pico_enable_stdio_uart(Monitor_Final 0)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(Monitor_Final 1)

# 3. Vincular TODAS las librerías de hardware necesarias para la integración total
target_link_libraries(Monitor_Final
        pico_stdlib
        FatFs_SPI        # Motor de la MicroSD (SPI1)
        hardware_adc     # Lectura de ECG y Micrófono
        hardware_spi     # Comunicación con la Pantalla TFT (SPI0)
        hardware_i2c     # Comunicación con el MPU6050
        hardware_dma     # Transferencia ultrarrápida a la pantalla
)

# Carpeta de archivos de inclusión estándar
target_include_directories(Monitor_Final PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
)

pico_add_extra_outputs(Monitor_Final)
